Class SlotMachine

java.lang.Object
SlotMachine
public class SlotMachine extends Object
Main controller for the Slot Machine simulator. This class handles the core logic, managing the wheels, the authorized symbols, and the overall visual state of the game.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Santiago Cordoba - Camilo Rivas

  • Constructor Details

    • SlotMachine

      public SlotMachine()
      Constructs a new Slot Machine. Initializes the empty collections and sets up the default visual background.

  • Method Details

    • makeVisible

      public void makeVisible()
      Displays the slot machine and all its components on the screen.

    • makeInvisible

      public void makeInvisible()
      Hides the slot machine and all its components from the screen.

    • addWheel

      public void addWheel(int pos)
      Adds a new wheel to the machine at the position (pos). It also calculates the appropriate spatial coordinates to ensure the wheel is perfectly aligned within the machine's casing.
      Parameters:
      pos - The position where the wheel should be inserted, starting from 1.

    • delWheel

      public void delWheel(int pos)
      Removes a wheel from the machine.
      Parameters:
      pos - The position of the wheel to remove, from 1.

    • addSymbol

      public void addSymbol(int pos, String color)
      Registers a new authorized symbol color into the machine's system.
      Parameters:
      pos - The position in the registry where the symbol will be saved, starting from 1.
      color - The specific color name of the symbol.

    • delSymbol

      public void delSymbol(String symbol)
      Deletes a registered symbol from the machine's system using its color name.
      Parameters:
      symbol - The exact color name of the symbol to delete.

    • placeSymbol

      public void placeSymbol(int wheel, String symbol)
      Places a specific authorized symbol in the wheel.
      Parameters:
      wheel - The position of the target wheel, starting from 1.
      symbol - The color of the symbol to place.

    • spin

      public void spin(int wheel)
      Triggers a spin on a single, specific wheel.
      Parameters:
      wheel - The position of the wheel to spin, starting from 1.

    • spin

      public void spin()
      Triggers a simultaneous spin on all the wheels currently installed in the machine.

    • symbols

      public String[] symbols()
      Retrieves the colors of all symbols currently configured on the first wheel.
      Returns:
      An array of strings representing the colors on the first wheel.

    • distinctSymbols

      public int distinctSymbols()
      Calculates the total amount of unique symbol colors installed across every wheel.
      Returns:
      The exact count of unique symbols.

    • configuration

      public String[] configuration()
      Gathers the current visual state of the machine by checking which symbol is displayed on each wheel from left to right.
      Returns:
      An array containing the colors of the currently visible symbols.

    • isJackpot

      public boolean isJackpot()
      Evaluates the current configuration to determine if the player has won the jackpot. A jackpot is awarded only if every visible symbol across all wheels matches perfectly. If won, the machine will celebrate by illuminating its background.
      Returns:
      True if the current configuration is a jackpot, false otherwise.

    • exit

      public void exit()
      Safely closes the simulation by hiding all components and clearing the screen.

    • ok

      public boolean ok()
      Checks the success status of the most recently executed method.
      Returns:
      True if the last operation completed successfully, false if it failed.
